svg.text: Coin (convex; harmonics 1–35, Fejér weights, amplitude per harmonic R/72, center 90°)
Cup (well-shaped; width 30°, depth h = 23/72 R, harmonics 0–71, Fejér weights, center 60°)
Cup: g(ψ) = h (1 − W/2π) − Σ (1 − m/(N+1)) (2h / mπ) sin(mW/2) cos m(ψ − θ) (well width W, depth h)
Cross term: c(ψ) = 2 f(coin) g(cup). It has the dimension R², so it is divided by R once and drawn as a length: r(ψ) = R + c(ψ)/R
Value at the coin center (90°) c = +0.1535 R²; waveform maximum +0.1535 R² (90.0°), minimum -0.0044 R² (240.0°)
Value of the cup at the coin center g = +0.3158 R; coin peak f = +0.2431 R
